title: Longtime St. Louis, University Alumni Leader to Receive Magis Award
summary_en: SummaryAt the Rockhurst University Leadership Series in St. Louis Sept. 17, the University will honor Jim Powers, ’83, with its Magis Award, honoring his decades of service and leadership for the University and the St. Louis community.
